claims.content: Vouchers have been created and are available in the system stock.
At least one distributor has been registered in the Distributor Master.
At least one sales team member has been registered in the Sales Team Master.
The VMU User is authenticated and logged into the system.

If the distributor or salesman name is not available in the system, then the system has a provision to navigate quickly to its master screen and enter the new Distributor and Salesman details, without closing the present screen.

While entering the No of vouchers required, the system should automatically pick the Batch No's with voucher No's from the available voucher stock and list the details of each voucher with below information's as a grid format.
The system has recorded the details of the voucher sales transaction between the MISU sales team and the Distributor.
The system has updated the available voucher stock by allocating specific vouchers (identified by Batch No and Voucher No) to the distributor based on the quantity sold.
An auto-generated Distribution Invoice Number has been created for the transaction.
The invoice amount has been calculated automatically as the product of the Whole Sale Rate and the Quantity Sold.
The distribution details are now available for reporting purposes, including distributor-wise, salesman-wise, and batch-wise sales reports.
